evals.prompt: Our portfolio list shows daily change in data/up and data/down at 12 px. Is that accessible in light and dark?
evals.expected_output: Analysis with computed ratios showing small text in data/up and data/down fails 4.5:1 on light surfaces and data/down fails on dark surface, with alternatives and a non-colour cue.
expectations: Reports about 3.8:1 for data/up or data/down on white and calls it a failure for small text
Reports data/down on the dark surface below 4.5:1
Requires a sign or arrow in addition to colour
Suggests escalating a passing text token to the Governance
